** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Fix the sign-out dialog text. It implies a cloud copy that Final builds never create.** Final mode now saves the PDF only on the device. It writes only report metadata to Firestore. The dialog still says "Bản đã tải lên … vẫn còn" ("uploaded copies remain"). Line 103 is unchanged and carries this wording. A user may believe a cloud copy of the PDF exists. The user then signs out and loses the only copy. The NC-04 goal is to never present a missing local PDF as an available cloud PDF. Keep the "PDF đã lưu trên máy này sẽ bị xóa" prefix. The test at `test/profile/profile_screen_test.dart` line 290 matches it. Replace the second sentence on line 103:
